thread:
Alicia: Heads-up — HyperLogix emailed a headcount/leadtime update for our H100 pool. Original ETA was ~6w, they now quote 9-11w. They offered a split: 20 units by air (expedite, earlier) + 20 by sea (later). Also flagged RMA routing change: vendor prefers EU-bound RMAs to go to their FRA repair depot (says will save turnaround).

Samir: Ugh. Do they say why the slip?

vendor-hyperlogix-bot: Forwarded vendor note from hyperlogix@ops: "Supply chain thermal backlog at SubFab-3; prioritizing enterprise partners per confirmed PO schedule. Proposed split shipment to mitigate immediate needs. AWB placeholder: HYP-0424-ETA-NA-AIR (partial). RMA routing: FRA depot (vendor-owned) for EU returns; NA returns to vendor third-party in CA. Insurer: GlobalCover. Expedited air uplift: 18% on unit price. Deposit for split: 30% on air tranche."

Mike: 18% expedite is steep but expected. The bigger problem: they want to change RMA endpoints. We already have a FRA nodal SLA but vendor-owned depot needs to be verified for chain-of-custody and E2E repair SLA.

Jane Ops: Agree. If we accept split, prefer we map by region (air -> NA, sea -> EU) to avoid cross-border warranty headaches. Also need serial manifest before handoff. Vendor previously tried to ship without full manifest once — that caused recon hell.

Samir: Can we push them for better commercial terms? 18% + 30% deposit — ask to cap expedite to 10% and deposit to 15% for first tranche. Propose net30 after delivery for balance.

Ryan (Logistics): I can ask for manifest and insurance uplift details. Also request they route RMAs to our preferred FRA repair partner (not vendor-owned) or at minimum share SLA + repair ticketing API access. If vendor refuses we need to think about customs implications (import/export entries if FRA depot owned by vendor).

Alicia: Good plan. Also note: dedic-pool queue is sensitive — if we accept partial air we should reserve those 20 to Dedicated customers only (no public burst), otherwise we blow our commit. Ops, can you flag capacity?

Mike: Flagging now. If air tranche is for Dedicated we need documented allocation and a PO amendment. Without it we can't earmark.

Jane Ops: Small ops checklist before we greenlight split:
- vendor provides serial manifest in CSV at least 48h before ship
- AWB numbers & carrier + ETA windows
- insurance value and policy name (insurer + policy number)
- confirm RMA depot address, hours, SLA (TAT for diagnosis/repair), and customs EORI for inbound returns
- revised invoice with expedite uplift line item

Samir: I'll draft negotiation points to send. Suggest: expedite cap 10%, deposit 15% refundable if vendor misses first tranche ETA by >7 days, manifest delivered 72h ahead, repair SLA 10 business days diagnosis, and we retain right to choose RMA depot for EU units.

vendor-hyperlogix-bot: Vendor reply (parsed): "Can do manifest 72h, deposit 25% firm due to air freighter booking costs, expedite fee negotiable down to 14% for this account, cannot change FRA depot for EU — it's contractual with their forwarder. Offer: expedite 14%, deposit 25%, refund clause: 50% refund of deposit if vendor misses air ETA by >10 days."

Alicia: Not great but workable if we get stronger refund SLA. 25% deposit + 14% expedite still better than full wait. Are we ok with vendor-owned FRA depot if they provide ticketing/visibility?

Mike: Only if we can tie repair SLA to credits. E.g., credit per unit-day of extended downtime beyond 14 days. Also need photo proof at arrival for damage claims.

Ryan (Logistics): I'll ask for the following exact text in the contract amendment:
```
Vendor agrees to provide:
- Full serial manifest (CSV: serial, model, PO#, SKU) 72 hours pre-shipment
- AWB numbers 48 hours pre-arrival
- Insurance: GlobalCover policy #GC-2024-HYP; coverage value per unit and beneficiary details
- RMA endpoints: FRA depot contact + API ticket endpoint + daily status CSV; TAT for diagnosis <=10 business days; per-unit downtime credit: €500/day after day 14, capped at unit value
- Deposit: 25% for air tranche, balance net30 after delivery; expedite uplift: 14%
```

Jane Ops: That credit amount seems OK as a negotiating anchor. If vendor counters, we can reduce cap but keep per-day credit. Also we should require HS codes and indicate any DDP/DDU responsibilities.

Samir: I'll send that amendment. Also ask them to confirm whether they can re-route RMAs to our preferred FRA partner if we pay an additional handling fee — gives us leverage.

Alicia: Thanks. Ryan/Jane/Mike — if vendor accepts manifest + API visibility + credit terms, greenlight split and we allocate 20 to Dedicated NA pool. Otherwise we hold for full shipment and accept longer ETA.

Ryan (Logistics): Reaching out to hyperlogix now. Sending them PO amendment draft. Leaving note: carrier options for air are LH Cargo or CargoX; LH cheaper but later availability.

vendor-hyperlogix-bot: HyperLogix acked receipt of amendment request and said they'd respond EOD with counteroffer.

Samir: :thumbsup: keep us posted. If they push back hard I'll escalate to procurement to pause the PO until terms are acceptable.

Alicia: Thanks everyone. Tagging @procurement to monitor. I'll update thread when vendor returns with counters.

Mike: One last ops ask — if we accept split, let's schedule a pre-shipment serial audit with vendor (remote video) to avoid manifest discrepancies.

Jane Ops: +1. Remote audit 48-24h pre-pick confirmed as a condition.

Ryan (Logistics): Noted. I'll add to amendment.

Alicia: Closing loop for now — awaiting vendor counter (EOD).
